the endorsement accorded a formal leader increases when the leader's group succeeds, the payoff distribution is relatively flat, and the leader is not perceived as vulnerable.

(1) group success-failure and the distribution of payoffs in the group affect endorsement of the formal leader, (2) the effect of success is mediated by attributed leader competence, and (3) the effect of the distribution of pay-offs is mediated by attributed fair treatment of the group by its leader.
